introduction: Idaho Legal Aid’s advice line provides civil legal advice for eligible callers. Use its current advice-line page for intake hours, since older contact pages list different schedules.

sections.who: The organization screens income, assets and the legal issue. Advice-line areas include housing, public benefits, seniors, and domestic or sexual violence. Criminal cases are outside this civil service.
sections.get: Accepted callers can receive advice from an Idaho attorney at no charge. Full representation is not guaranteed and weekly intake capacity can be limited.
sections.docs:
• Keep notices, agreements and court papers in front of you.
  • Prepare income and asset information for screening.
  • Know the next deadline and have a reliable callback number.
sections.apply:
1. Check current intake hours

    The advice-line page lists Monday–Wednesday, 10 a.m.–1:30 p.m. Mountain Time; Pacific Time is an hour earlier.

  2. Call for screening

    Call 208-746-7541. Explain the issue, your county and any hearing or response deadline.

  3. Confirm the assistance

    Ask whether the result is advice, a brief service, referral or accepted representation, and what to do next.
sections.after: Record the lawyer’s instructions and keep tracking deadlines. If appointments are full, ask about the next intake opportunity or an alternative provider.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using Current Idaho Legal Aid advice-line intake. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.

faqs: Will the advice line represent me in court?
Full representation is not guaranteed. Ask what help has actually been accepted.
The program lists public benefits among its advice-line areas, subject to eligibility and capacity.
